geoRadio_toggle.title: Geo Radio: show / hide window
geoRadio_toggle.desc: Shows or hides the Geo Radio station list (Ctrl+Alt+R).

geoRadio_next.title: Geo Radio: tune up
geoRadio_next.desc: Tunes up to the next station by frequency (Ctrl+Alt+N).

geoRadio_prev.title: Geo Radio: tune down
geoRadio_prev.desc: Tunes down to the previous station by frequency (Ctrl+Alt+B).

geoRadio_stop.title: Geo Radio: play / pause
geoRadio_stop.desc: Pauses the radio, or plays the last station again. Unbound by default.

geoRadio_favorite.title: Geo Radio: add / remove favorite
geoRadio_favorite.desc: Adds the playing station to the favorites, or removes it (Ctrl+Alt+F).

geoRadio_saveSong.title: Geo Radio: save the song
geoRadio_saveSong.desc: Saves the playing song's artist and title to the list (Ctrl+Alt+S).

geoRadio_compact.title: Geo Radio: compact window
geoRadio_compact.desc: Switches the window between the full list and the compact player. Unbound by default.
